STE review: you published an artifact. If it has more than 150 words of prose, examine the full text now, before you tell the user it is done:
1. Terms: find all words for each key idea. If one idea has two or more words ("uses" / "references" / "refs"), use one.
2. Phrasal verbs ("set up", "go through", "flow up", "get to"): replace them with one verb.
3. Sentences: 15 words max for procedures, 20 for descriptions. Paragraphs: 4 sentences max.
4. Tables: 6 columns and 15 rows max; cells are fragments of 8 words max; no empty cells.
5. Graphs: labels 4 words max; diagrams 10 nodes max.
6. Length: more than 1,500 words or 7 top-level sections -> split into tabs.
7. Visuals: replace prose that describes a flow, a call order or a structure with a graph, a call stack or a snippet.
8. Foldables: put each repeated item segment (3 or more items with the same structure) into a foldable.
9. No references to the session or the chat ("in this session", "the briefing").
If you find issues, fix the source file and publish it again to the same artifact. Full rules: references/layout.md in the technical-english skill.
